campaign.title: Hard-M1 t=1 rho-large Farey-covector sparsity gate

resource_policy.computation_policy: Mathematica may check finite signed-inverse, canonical-quotient, covector-factorization, floor, coverage, and multiplicity identities only. Every computation is diagnostic_only and cannot certify an asymptotic estimate.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact Round-191 rho-large remainder be reduced further by a target-safe union of small unimodular Farey covectors of the canonical inverse matrix, with an exact badly-approximable core, and can that core be estimated by a genuinely literal phase/carry mechanism or shown to resist the proposed iteration?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Fix Q=H_B, U=mq>4Q, q>Q, Qm<Y, the exact Round-189 fast projective condition, and the Round-191 remainder |rho_U(v)|>T=min((U-1)/2,floor(QmU/Y)) after its terminal and isolated Fejer projections. For v0=[v]_U define rho v0-beta U=1. For 1<=c< U and 0<=d<=c define ell_(c,d)=c beta-d rho, so rho(c v0-dU)=c+U ell_(c,d). With A=min(U-1,floor(Q^C0)), prove the union T>=1 and min_(c,d coprime,c<=A)|ell_(c,d)|<=T target-safe at fixed scale Qm kappa u X^epsilon and through the exact outer ledger, or locate the first exact failure.
quantities: The canonical beta uses v0=[v]_U in 1,...,U-1. It is not the actual transport quotient gamma=(rho v-1)/U for a noncanonical literal representative.
For fixed c,d,ell the exact identity rho(c v0-dU)=c+U ell converts residue classes into divisor pairs; c<U prevents a zero right side.
The Farey family has O(Q^(2C0)) members, a fixed polylogarithmic cost that may be absorbed only through a fresh epsilon budget.
The T=0 sector is defined empty; isolated ell=0 classes may not be called target-safe when the density budget is below one residue class.
The inherited literal v support has total length O(u), U divides u, and each residue class occurs O(u/U+1)=O(u/U) times; projective bands and literal masks only delete rows.
Both orientations, all remaining jump sources, every endpoint field, phase, carry, mask, and zero extension remain in one complex aggregate before the final real part.
A full-core claim needs cancellation for the fixed literal coefficients. Farey separation alone supplies no cancellation for arbitrary bounded arrays.

Even complete rho-large success closes at most the exact original-t=1 residual through accepted connectors; every original t>=2 range, near resonance, smooth M1, M2, endpoint, bridge, theorem, and exponent remains separate.

completion_criteria: Derive the signed canonical quotient and exact covector factorization without conflating canonical residue, literal representative, or transport quotient.
Prove or refute the O(T X^eta) residue-class count for each covector, including negative rho, ell=0, T=0, floors, c<U, and factor multiplicity.

Restore literal interval multiplicity, projective-band restriction, Y heights, kappa sites, the exact m^(-1)c_q(a) lift, coefficient mass, Farey-family size, dyadic bands, divisor sums, and every Q,L,Y,X power.
Produce an exact one-outer-real-part safe projection and complement; do not double-count the Round-191 terminal or Fejer projections.

Attempt the badly-approximable core only with a proved literal phase, carry, endpoint, or arithmetic correlation; otherwise give a quantified no-go for Farey covering, bounded arrays, or positive recombination.
Receive a statement-only independent rederivation of the factorization, count, exceptions, strongest coverage corollary, and method boundary.
Run finite Mathematica controls only for exact identities, multiplicities, signs, floors, saturation, and proposed coverage; archive code, output, and limitations.

Review normalization, divisor multiplicity, literal representative scope, Farey-family power cost, outer ledger, exact complement, blind post-unmask consistency, downstream owner scope, and exponent quarantine before promotion.

Apply no graph change without a mechanically valid State Patch, independent reverse/replay audit, green lifecycle validation, and one declared terminal label. Do not pivot in-round to another owner or exponent.

closing_assessment.main_result: The exact small-Farey-covector union inside the Round-191 rho-large hard-M1 t=1 remainder is target-safe by Bezout factorization, signed-divisor sparsity, literal multiplicity, and the full outer ledger. Circular pigeonhole gives the exact strict core and an empty-core criterion. The nonempty jointly signed core remains open with deficit Y/(H_Bm).
